SELECT c.id, c.no, c.status, CASE WHEN c.status = 'DRAFT' THEN c.reject_reason END AS reject_reason, c.order_id, o.no AS order_no, c.change_types AS change_types_text, c.reason, c.responsible_party, c.fee_note, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.audit_by, c.audit_time FROM c JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = c.order_id
ORDER BY c.create_time DESC, c.id DESC

SELECT c.status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM c JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = c.order_id
GROUP BY c.status UNION ALL SELECT 'REJECTED', COUNT(*) FROM c JOIN ord_order o ON o.id = c.order_id
AND c.status = 'DRAFT' AND c.reject_reason IS NOT NULL HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
